title: Orch Neural Network: an on-device GPT-2 visualiser for iOS
description: An iOS app that runs DistilGPT2 from scratch in Swift on Accelerate and visualises every step of next-word prediction: tokens, embeddings, attention heads, MLP neurons, the logit lens across layers, output probabilities, and every weight matrix as a heatmap, framed as how keyboard suggestions work. Includes a numpy reference implementation and tests.
